catalogue.note: The redesigned Profile. Drawn in Figma at 0.75 of real size (270×600; instances carry scaleFactor 0.75): built at 360×800 with every value divided by 0.75 (type 24/16/14/11/10, rows 280×64 with a 32px icon disc). Square-cornered: the frame’s own 12px corners are left off and the diff leaves the four corners out. The rows sit in a plain frame at fixed offsets, not auto-layout; kept. The Referrals card was drawn after the scale, at round numbers of its own (236×48 at x 17.8037, radius 8, 1px white at 60% inside, shadow 0 1 8 black 8%): divided by 0.75 like everything else, so it lands on 314.667×64, radius 10.667, shadow 0 1.333 10.667. Its chevron carries the orange gradient. The name is Satoshi Black with the #FF7500 to #FF9000 gradient; the name is the design’s sample user. The navbar’s top line is a 2px outside stroke, #696969 at 4%, multiplied. Status bar, bottom bar and every icon are Figma’s SVG export of the vectors, unchanged. Type is live Satoshi from the files on this Mac, embedded whole. Figma snaps each text baseline to a whole pixel at its own 0.75 scale and Chrome floors its own at this one: the type styles where the two land apart carry the difference as a sub-pixel offset, so at 3× every string sits on Figma’s baseline (0px off, all strings measured) and at 1× within a third of a pixel, except 16px labels, which sit two thirds high. What is left in the diff is glyph and curve antialiasing; flat fills match exactly.
